Evidence Summary: Agentforce operates autonomously via the Atlas Reasoning Engine, analyzing incoming user queries or events, classifying intents under configured Topics, and independently selecting and executing actions (such as Salesforce Flows, Apex, prompt templates, or API calls) without scripted decision trees.
Evaluation Notes: Operates autonomously within configured Topic instructions, action targets, and guardrails to perform tasks rather than just generate responses.

Evidence Summary: The Atlas Reasoning Engine employs a ReAct-based planning and reasoning framework that translates complex user goals into step-wise execution plans, dynamically orchestrates tool invocations, and assesses intermediate outcomes, treating execution plans as living documents adjusted during multi-step reasoning.
Evaluation Notes: Combines LLM reasoning with deterministic logic via Agent Script and Atlas dynamic tool selection.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce orchestrates business workflows using modular building blocks (Topics, Instructions, and Actions) and Agent Script. It supports deterministic action chaining, conditional branching, subagent routing, transitions, and direct connections to Salesforce Flow, Apex classes, MuleSoft APIs, and external REST endpoints.
Evaluation Notes: Supports visual flow authoring in Flow Builder as well as programmatic script definitions.

Evidence Summary: Context assembly combines multi-turn conversational history (via Agent Script variables and dialogue state tracking) with real-time semantic grounding from Salesforce CRM and Data Cloud records across session turns.
Evaluation Notes: Evidence supports real-time CRM/Data Cloud grounding and session state memory; does not establish general-purpose persistent long-term memory across independent sessions.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce logs prompts, responses, and trust signals in Data 360/Data Cloud. The Agentforce Testing Center and Connect APIs provide automated evaluation suites, custom scoring criteria, and simulated testing in sandboxes to iteratively refine prompts, instructions, and Agent Scripts based on feedback.
Evaluation Notes: Supports iterative human-guided refinement and automated regression testing; does not represent autonomous continual model retraining from live production data.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce supports multi-agent architectures where specialized agents, subagents, and connected subagents collaborate, share context, delegate domain-specific subtasks, and coordinate across distinct business workflows in the same Salesforce org.
Evaluation Notes: Connected-subagent multi-agent orchestration is documented as a Beta service.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce Builder provides a declarative low-code/no-code graphical interface and built-in AI assistance to define agent topics, assign actions, configure natural-language instructions, and preview/test responses interactively using clicks.
Evaluation Notes: Includes conversational prompt-based agent generation, prebuilt templates, and visual configuration tools.

Evidence Summary: Einstein 1 Studio Model Builder supports Bring Your Own Large Language Model (BYOLLM) and an LLM Open Connector, allowing organizations to connect external foundation models (such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) alongside Salesforce-hosted models, assignable per agent or subagent.
Evaluation Notes: Requires Data Cloud enablement for external model registration and custom endpoint connections.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce DX integrates with Salesforce CLI, Visual Studio Code extensions, Agent Script authoring, scratch orgs, visual Canvas, live draft previewing, and prebuilt reusable templates to streamline both pro-code and low-code agent creation and testing.
Evaluation Notes: Supports bi-directional synchronization between local developer projects and Salesforce orgs.

Evidence Summary: Agents connect to third-party tools and enterprise systems using MuleSoft Anypoint integration, Salesforce External Services via OpenAPI specifications, standard Apex classes, Flow HTTP callouts, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) solutions.
Evaluation Notes: Native MuleSoft ecosystem connectivity provides extensive enterprise API management and orchestration.

Evidence Summary: Agents can be deployed across multiple channels (Salesforce Omni-Channel, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Slack, WhatsApp, SMS, mobile apps, web chat) and moved across sandbox, scratch, and production orgs via Agentforce DX metadata deployment.
Evaluation Notes: Supports multi-channel engagement managed via Salesforce metadata; does not support arbitrary self-hosted runtime deployment.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce actions can require explicit user confirmation before execution. Additionally, native Omni-Channel routing and Agent Script escalation routines support seamless transfer of unresolved interactions to human service representatives with full conversation context.
Evaluation Notes: Enforces pre-action user confirmations and transparent context handover during human escalation.

Evidence Summary: Agentforce Observability delivers Session Tracing data models, step-by-step reasoning logs, topic quality scores, deflection/escalation analytics, and Agentforce Testing Center evaluation scores, queryable via Data Cloud and visualized in Tableau.
Evaluation Notes: Provides operational trace and source citation transparency; not formal model-feature attribution or causal explainability.

Evidence Summary: Executed natively within Salesforce Hyperforce, the Einstein Trust Layer enforces dynamic PII data masking, toxicity detection, CRM data grounding, audit logging, configurable guardrails, and contractual zero-data-retention agreements with third-party model providers.
Evaluation Notes: Comprehensive trust pipeline respecting granular Salesforce role-based permissions and data residency.

Evidence Summary: Built on Salesforce Hyperforce public cloud infrastructure and Data Cloud, Agentforce provides elastic compute scaling, global multi-region availability, and consumption-based scaling across channels (proven across >100k website and >2M Salesforce Help conversations).
Evaluation Notes: Native Hyperforce deployment supports global hyperscaler infrastructure and enterprise-scale concurrency.

Evidence Summary: Provides out-of-the-box domain-specific agents mapping directly to CRM and business operations, including Agentforce Service Agent, Sales Development Representative (SDR), Sales Coach, Commerce Agent, and Campaign Optimizer across sales, marketing, service, finance, and healthcare.
Evaluation Notes: Deep domain integration across Salesforce clouds and extensive cross-industry operational workflows.

Evidence Summary: A Forrester Total Economic Impact study demonstrated a 396% three-year ROI, 35% case deflection, 50% handling time reduction, and payback in under 12 months. Salesforce's internal deployment achieved a 40% reduction in qualification time and $20M in pipeline growth.
Evaluation Notes: Forrester study reflects independent composite financial modeling; internal deployment metrics are vendor-reported.
